source_check.method: Hugging Face API model_info(files_metadata=True); lfs.sha256 of each served file compared against the digest recorded when the lab downloaded it
source_check.result: All 11 archived lab digests that were checked matched the served files byte-for-byte. Corrections applied: (1) the conv-VAE entry previously carried the diffusion-VAE digest; the served conv file's actual digest is pinned as sha256_source; (2) the CQ enhancer, Q5_K_M GGUF, temporal upscaler, audio VAE and MSR V2 were pinned to the served-file digests; (3) three CQ mirror repos verified byte-identical.
source_check.runnable_mirror_note: Mirrors are exercised automatically when the primary source fails. A 404 now reports the exact asset id, role, filename, repository, repository path, and URL that failed.

notes: sha256 = digest recorded on the lab machine at download time and re-verified against the served file on 2026-09-30. sha256_source = digest of the file served by the recorded repository at source-check time; used for verification when the lab digest was never archived. The downloader verifies sha256 first, then sha256_source, and reports which one it used.

MiniMax H3 weights are subject to the MiniMax H3 Community License, which carries territorial restrictions. No profile downloads H3 weights; profile h3-byow validates user-supplied copies and can verify the two recorded LoRA digests.

Repositories are addressed by name; no Hugging Face revision pins are recorded. Verification is by content digest (sha256 / sha256_source), which fails closed if a served file changes. `download --check-sources` re-verifies every source and mirror without downloading.

archive_run_id / lab_record_id identify immutable records in the non-redistributed laboratory archive: campaign-prefixed ids (BENCH_YYYY-MM-DD_*) name dated campaign records, _sN is a section suffix, and '+' joins records that jointly support an entry. See docs/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md for the corpus map.
Gated repositories (for example the official Lightricks releases) require HF_TOKEN or huggingface-cli login; none of the downloadable entries here are gated.
